engineExpertQuestions.label: Target platform — desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux), mobile (iOS/Android), web (HTML5), or multiple
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Export templates, renderer choice (Forward+, Mobile, Compatibility), and threading restrictions all depend on the target.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Rendering backend — Forward+ (default, desktop), Mobile, or Compatibility (web/old hardware)
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Forward+ has the best visuals but does not run in the browser. Compatibility is required for HTML5 export.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Multiplayer — none, local co-op, or online (ENet / WebSocket)
engineExpertQuestions.hint: Godot's High-Level Multiplayer API changes the state synchronisation architecture significantly.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Save / persistence strategy — none, local file (ConfigFile / JSON), cloud save
engineExpertQuestions.hint: On HTML5 export, file access is via the virtual file system stored in IndexedDB, not the OS file system.

engineExpertQuestions.label: Scripting language — GDScript (default) or C#
engineExpertQuestions.hint: C# has better IDE tooling and performance for CPU-intensive code, but requires .NET SDK and does not run on iOS/web without extra configuration.
